title: Integrate FlashAttention-v3 fused rotary with KV-aware scheduler and reduced kernel launches
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: reduce end-to-end token latency and improve throughput for causal generation on Ampere+ GPUs by combining a FlashAttention v3-style fused attention kernel with an in-kernel rotary/rope application and a KV-cache-aware scheduling path. This PR introduces a new kernel that applies rotary embeddings and key/value interleaving inside the attention compute to eliminate separate transforms and extra device-to-device memory ops. It also adds a lightweight scheduler that prefers in-place KV layouts for streaming workloads and steps down to the v2 codepath for compatibility on unsupported hardware.

What changed (high level): fused attention kernel (flashattn_v3.cu) that: 1) applies rotary/rope rotations inside the per-head attention compute; 2) performs QKV projection packing and interleaves KV to match the KV-cache layout used by the runtime; 3) reduces kernel launches by merging scale, softmax + dropout + output matmul into a single fused pipeline for causal workloads. Added a kv-aware scheduler that selects the in-kernel-interleave path when streaming token rate and sequence patterns indicate benefit. Added fallbacks and runtime feature detection (compute capability, shared memory limits) so existing deployments remain functional when hardware does not support the new kernel.

Benchmarks: Microbenchmarks run on p4d/p3 and A100 infra. Representative improvements observed on language-modeling workloads (causal decode, batch size 1, short prompt expansions): p50 latency -18% to -27% (depending on seq_len), throughput (tokens/sec) +12% to +24% for short/medium contexts. For longer context (>=4096) p95 latency improvements were smaller (5-10%) due to memory-bound stages, but kernel-level GPU SM utilization improved by ~22%. Perf test harness added under tests/bench to reproduce these numbers and a CI perf check that validates no regressions vs a baseline (reference v2) within noise.

Compatibility and rollout: No API or wire-level change. The new kernel is optional and selected by runtime heuristics. We added a feature flag REDWOOD_USE_FLASHATTN_V3 to force the new path for testing. On merge the plan is a staged canary: 5% of hosted inference traffic -> 25% -> full, plus Dedicated canaries on reserve clusters. Observability: new tracing spans for kernel selection and KV-cache hit ratio, and dashboard updates in docs/perf/flashattn_v3.md. Fallthrough path keeps previous behavior to avoid regressions.

Checklist: implementations, unit and integration tests, bench harness, docs, canary plan, release notes drafted. Related Linear tasks: ENG-4257 (kernel integration), ENG-4312 (scheduler heuristics).

review_conversation: Liam: Can we guarantee numerical equivalence for rotary application? Request unit tests to compare against v2 for several dtypes and sequence lengths.
Author (Maya): Added test_rotary_fuse.py with deterministic inputs and float32/float16 checks; differences within eps for float16 confirmed. Added doc comment about fp16 rounding behavior.
Sofia: Concern about shared memory footprint on 80GB A100 vs 40GB variants. Suggest runtime detection and fallback.
Author: Implemented compute-cap detection; kernel chooses smaller tile sizes when shared mem is constrained and falls back to v2 if limits exceeded.
Devon: CI perf check failed initially on cuda-nightly due to ABI mismatch with a helper macro. Fixed by removing inline asm and adding compatibility shim. Reran CI, all green.
release_notes: Performance: Added optional FlashAttention-v3 fused kernel that applies rotary embeddings in-kernel and interleaves KV for streaming workloads; reduces kernel launches and improves token throughput by ~12-24% on Ampere-class GPUs. Safety: runtime feature detection and fallback to v2 ensure no behavior changes on unsupported hardware.
notes: Canary plan: enable REDWOOD_USE_FLASHATTN_V3 for 5% hosted traffic; monitor p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU SM util, kv_cache_hit_ratio. Rollback plan: flip feature flag to false to resume v2 path.
